## Step 1 - One-time setup
Run this workflow ONCE. It creates the Google Sheet **Treasury Audit - Demo Bank (Capstone)** with fictitious sample treasury data (deal blotter, investment register, counterparty & dealer limits, daily risk positions, SEBI PIT restricted list) plus empty Findings and Audit_Runs tabs.

All names and numbers are fictitious and for demonstration only. Replace with CBS / treasury-system extracts for a live audit.
